summary: No new work this final cycle; the draft bytes are the accepted correction from the previous cycle, so submitting them creates no duplicate revision. The run's record stands complete: one asserted defect (shouldSnapshot's unsigned comparison of the log store's last index against the cached snapshot index makes a node whose store sits below its snapshot index report that it should snapshot, witnessed after a TrailingLogs=0 user snapshot in CheckRun 9cba2e79ff6c4019b0f0381690d9aaab and after a follower installed a snapshot above its own log in CheckRun e5116cfe896549deb27799d6d871ed77, with the consequence measured as redundant snapshot attempts at the unchanged index in CheckRun a4a0cbfa094b4d1982032d9de0652861 and bounded to wasted snapshot work with no safety effect); three refuted suspicions with retained operands (non-voter acknowledgements cannot advance commitIndex, a restart preserves the durable last vote so no second different vote in a term, and the AddVoter configuration lag is a bounded replication transient); and four durable Behaviors/Facts, two of which were corrected under their own ids to drop the withdrawn per-interval implication. The only unmeasured aspect is the attempt-level cadence of the redundant snapshots.
